items.text: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) ruled OUT for MNF vs Cowboys.
items.why: Official injury report; Smith hamstring, Wicks ankle.
items.implication: AJ Brown massive target spike; Goedert/slot elevated; Saquon even more central if active.

items.text: Lamar Jackson (ankle) downgraded to OUT vs Bengals; Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.why: High ankle sprain; ruled out Saturday after limited practice week.
items.implication: Huntley start tanks Ravens pass game; fade Lamar-dependent pieces, stream Huntley only in deep 2QB.

items.text: Puka Nacua (calf) listed QUESTIONABLE; will test pregame after feeling lack of power/explosion Thursday.
items.why: Calf issue mid-practice Thursday; McVay says minor but GTD.
items.implication: If OUT, Stafford targets funnel to Higbee/Mumpfield/Parkinson; monitor early Sunday.

items.text: Josh Jacobs activated from exempt list and expected to play Sunday vs Lions.
items.implication: Immediate RB start but monitor snap share post-layoff; Berry hates due to workload questions.

items.text: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) QUESTIONABLE but expected to play MNF vs Cowboys after full/limited practices.
items.why: Returned to practice; full Saturday participation signals likely active.
items.implication: If active, immediate RB1 start vs DAL; reverse any handcuff beneficiaries.

items.text: Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel, Davante Adams all OUT; 49ers WR corps decimated.
items.why: Evans Achilles/ribs, Deebo hamstring, Adams (listed OUT).
items.implication: Kittle and CMC (possible slot) massive funnel; Christian Kirk debut.

items.text: Breece Hall (quad) QUESTIONABLE; Berry starts him if active vs Dolphins despite Stephania caution.
items.implication: If plays, start as RB1/2 in good matchup; else Allen surge.

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT (hamstring); Bijan Robinson full bellcow + 49ers DvP inflates opposing RBs 4.4%.
items.why: BRob ruled OUT; recent SF RB receptions high (White/Holani/Harvey/Love).
items.implication: Bijan elite RB1 with full carries + receiving vs soft DvP.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts vs Falcons: scheme + entire 49ers WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo/Adams OUT).
items.why: WR injuries force funnel; National TE Day irrelevant historically.
items.implication: Elite TE1 start; high target/route share expected.

items.text: CMC tempted for more slot WR work amid 49ers WR injuries; rarely buys RB-as-WR but dire situation + Black presence.
items.why: CMC smiled at slot question; WRs decimated.
items.implication: Possible receiving boost on top of RB role.

items.text: Colston Loveland BACK with Caleb: 30% TS, 19.2 PPR/g, 6+ rec/60+ yds both games since return.
TreVeyon Henderson down to just 21% snaps last three weeks; clear downgrade.
Luther Burden elite 2.56 YPRR on only 68.8% routes; Kmet IR likely boosts snaps/routes further.
items.implication: Breakout WR upside, higher route share.

items.text: Berry LOVES Jaylen Warren (@NO), Chuba Hubbard (vs TB), Bucky Irving (@CAR) for big workloads in friendly matchups; HATES Josh Jacobs post-layoff.
items.why: Workload + matchup edges for loves; Jacobs layoff concerns.
items.implication: Start Warren/Hubbard/Irving; caution Jacobs despite activation.
